notes.title: PathUp! Control & Mechanics Overhaul
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505714/6f379d1f459cb3f6ca90847fe5a30f43c0b7ea20.png"][/img][/p][p]🚗 [b]A New Era of Control in PathUp![/b][/p][p]We’ve released a major update that makes the gameplay [b]smoother, more exciting, and more fair[/b] than ever before. Here’s what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔧 [b]Improved Car Handling[/b]
The vehicle now responds much better to your input — [b]driving feels more realistic and dynamic[/b]. Turns are tighter, movements are smoother, and everything is more responsive.[/p][p]📷 [b]Camera Fixes[/b]
No more camera getting in the way! The camera now stays properly behind the vehicle and doesn’t block your view during gameplay.[/p][p]🗑️ [b]Old “Reset Car” Mechanic Removed[/b]
We’ve removed the outdated reset function. Instead, we’ve added something much more fun and skill-based:[/p][p]🦘 [b]Double Jump Mechanic![/b]
Press [b]\[E][/b] to jump — you’ll see a blue indicator appear.
When the indicator [b]starts pulsing[/b], press [b]\[E][/b] again to perform a [b]Double Jump[/b].[/p][list][*][p]✅ If your timing is right, the indicator turns [b]green[/b], and you’ll launch into the air![/p][/*][*][p]❌ Press too early or too late, and it turns [b]red[/b] — the jump fails.[/p][/*][/list][p]🔁 [b]Auto-Stabilization[/b]
Even if the car flips over, it now [b]automatically straightens out quickly[/b], keeping the gameplay fluid and frustration-free.[/p][hr][/hr][p]✨ [b]What does this mean for players?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]More intuitive[/b] and [b]stable controls[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]No more annoying resets or camera issues[/b][/p][/*][*][p]A skill-based jump system that rewards precision[/p][/*][*][p]A smoother, more fun experience overall[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔥 Try the update now — launch [b]PathUp![/b] and feel the difference![/p]

notes.title: 🔥 PathUp! Update — New Modes for Every Climber!
notes.notes:
PathUp! just leveled up — and so can you. With the latest update, the game now offers three distinct difficulty modes tailored for every type of player:

✦ Easy Mode – a smooth journey with 13 checkpoints

✦ Medium Mode – a real challenge with just 5 checkpoints

✦ Hard Mode – for true masters: only 1 checkpoint

Every climb is a test. Every mistake matters. Whether you want a relaxing experience or a nerve-wracking thrill, PathUp! now adapts to your playstyle.

🚀 The update is live! Download now and see how far you can go.

notes.title: PathUp — New Update: Higher, Better!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the players who have shared their feedback. In this update, I’ve focused on fixing some of the most critical issues, such as unclear collisions and invisible surfaces. Now, certain areas will have more precise hitboxes, preventing unexpected vehicle stalls or falls.

Additionally, new checkpoints have been added, allowing players to rejoin the game with minimal loss.

The most notable change is that the game’s end point has been moved from 2300 meters to 2550 meters. So, your journey is now a bit longer, a bit more challenging, but definitely more exciting.

The game continues to evolve, and I’ll keep listening to everyone’s voice.
